component.name: CredTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "checkChannelCred" end sub
sub checkChannelCred() port = createObject("roMessagePort") store = createObject("roSGNode", "ChannelStore") store.observeField("channelCred", port) store.command = "getChannelCred" pending = (store.channelCred = invalid) msg = wait(2000, port) if type(msg) <> "roSGNodeEvent" m.top.result = "timed out" return end if json = parseJson(msg.getData().json) m.top.result = "pending: " + pending.toStr() + ", channel_data: " + json.channel_data end sub
